stemMd: What is the domain of f(x) = log₁₀(9 − x²)?
explanationMd: The logarithm requires 9 − x² > 0, so x² < 9. This is equivalent to −3 < x < 3. Endpoints give zero argument and must be excluded.

distractorRationale.c: A logarithm cannot have zero as its argument.
distractorRationale.d: The argument is negative outside the interval.
distractorRationale.b: This still includes negative logarithm arguments.
distractorRationale.e: The input x itself need not be positive; the argument must be.
